authority.source: Human go after the reviewed WF00-first plan
authority.scope: Current model, gate, concurrency, and retry selection for supervised coding-delivery bootstrap only
authority.futureWork: Every later node requires its own explicit G0 admission

concurrency.gateSlotReviewMode: Verifier and reviewer sessions run as separate sequential gate turns
concurrency.backpressureAtQueueMaximum: Pause new worker dispatch until the queue is reduced

gates.g0: Root-pinned dependencies, owner, exact file allowlist, acceptance, baseline, and environment; missing/negative evidence blocks assignment
gates.g1: Worker submission and self-check; not independent approval
gates.g2: Different-session Luna Max verification on the exact submitted revision
gates.g2r: Mandatory independent review by a different Luna Max session from both worker and verifier on the same exact verified revision; no review receipt means BLOCKED
gates.g3: GPT-6.1-Sol resolves the task decision after G2 and G2R; the decision cannot grant domain-owner, Business, provider, or production authority
gates.highImpactOrUncertainCase: GPT-6.1-Sol makes the task disposition; when required domain-owner authority is missing, park for that owner instead of substituting model judgment
gates.g3b: GPT-6.1-Sol root integrates only after G2, G2R, and G3 receipts; recheck scope, pins, conflicts, and exact evidence
gates.g4: Required CI must attest the exact reviewed PR head and required ancestors; head change invalidates affected review and CI
gates.g5: GPT-6.1-Sol final gate checks the integrated revision and exact-head CI before merge
gates.g6: Separate owner release/activation decision with target, environment, migration, rollback, and receipt evidence
gates.sotCloseout: Reconcile through the owning canonical source of truth after the authorized delivery action
gates.safeCleanup: Only after SOT closeout and evidence retention, after confirming no active assignment, process, lease, or unpreserved worktree state
gates.negativeEvidence: Any required failure, missing proof, stale pin, scope escape, unknown authority, unavailable model, or failed command blocks PASS

toolRetry.prerequisites: Same operation/input revision and idempotency must be established from evidence

authorityBoundary.currentScope: WF00 admitted documentation-only bootstrap; no global controller, product runtime, provider, Business, external-write, migration, release, deployment, or production authority
